lines_of_business: All lines of business unless noted in Program Exceptions
sections_in_order: Billing/Coding Information (CPT, ICD-10 Diagnosis Codes That Support Medical Necessity)
Reimbursement Information (frequency caps, LOINC documentation table)
criteria_location: Position Statement p.1-2 holds everything clinical: three bullet lists (diagnostic, therapeutic/maintenance, ultrasound exclusion) plus a footnote (*) that defines conservative management. Frequency caps are split off into the Reimbursement Information section (8 per 12 months per code family), a second place that restates and conflicts in kind with the 6-per-region cap in the Position Statement.
procedures_covered: Interlaminar epidural 62320-62323 (cervical/thoracic, lumbar/sacral, with and without imaging)
Diagnostic, therapeutic and maintenance epidural injections as three named categories
Epidural injection before an intrathecal drug-delivery system trial (added 04/30/25)

logic.top_level: pathways (diagnostic list; therapeutic/maintenance list; intrathecal-pump-trial one-liner; ultrasound = investigational)
logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: No contraindication list. The only exclusion is a one-sentence investigational statement: ultrasound guidance 'for any indication'. Z79.01 (long-term anticoagulants) appears in the ICD-10 'support medical necessity' list, which is odd (it is a bleeding-risk code).
logic.initial_vs_repeat: Yes, by category not by chart history: diagnostic (first) vs therapeutic and maintenance. 'Previous epidural injections provided at least 50% pain relief or improvement in functional status'; at least 14 days between therapeutic, 2 months between maintenance, 7 days between diagnostic; max 6 injections per region in a rolling 12 months.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Previous epidural injections provided at least 50% pain relief or improvement in functional status
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'or' joins relief and function; 'previous injections' plural does not say whether the most recent one or any one must meet 50%. No duration of relief required.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Diagnostic epidural injections performed for treatment of neck or back pain meet the definition of medical necessity
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'Diagnostic' here is a label for the first injection series, not a diagnostic block in the Carelon sense; a parser may confuse it with selective nerve root blocks. It is never defined, and nothing says when an injection stops being diagnostic and becomes therapeutic.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Therapeutic and maintenance epidural injections ... meets the definition of medical necessity when the following are met
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Therapeutic and maintenance are lumped in one criteria list but have different intervals (14 days vs 2 months); the list is not split per type, so a machine must decide which interval applies.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Use of prescription-strength analgesics ... including anti-inflammatory medications with or without adjunctive medications ... or documentation in the medical record of inability to tolerate these medications, AND Participation in at least 4 weeks of physical therapy ... or documentation ... of inability to tolerate physical therapy
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Medication has no stated duration (only PT has 4 weeks). Each leaf has its own inline 'or inability to tolerate' escape, so the tree needs an any(performed, intolerance-documented) wrapper per item.

definitions_that_change_meaning.definition_quote: a type of pain that radiates into an extremity directly along the course of a spinal nerve root; caused by compression, inflammation and/or injury to a spinal nerve root
also called mechanical pain, axial pain is confined to one spot or region

vague_terms.problem: No scale or number; 'persistent' has no duration.

vague_terms.quote: prescription-strength analgesics at a dose sufficient to induce a therapeutic response
vague_terms.problem: Dose adequacy is a clinical judgment; no drug, dose or duration.

vague_terms.quote: Evaluation and appropriate management of associated cognitive and behavioral issues, if present
vague_terms.problem: Conditional on 'if present'; 'appropriate' undefined; a chart that is silent cannot be told from a chart with none present.

vague_terms.quote: demonstrated spinal nerve root compression on imaging
vague_terms.problem: No modality (MRI vs CT), no age limit on the study, no required correlation with level treated.

extraction_hazards: Criteria are in bulleted lists with 'AND' at line ends; wrapped lines mix bullet and continuation text.
The asterisk footnote defining conservative management sits below the therapeutic list, so a parser that reads top-down attaches it to the wrong list.
ICD-10 table has a typo 'M51.14 - M54.17' (probably M51.17) and a code range split across lines ('M50.120 -' / 'M50.123').
Repeated page header block of nav tabs (Position Statement / Billing/Coding ...) is extracted as text.
LOINC table has seven near-identical rows that look like criteria but are documentation hints.
interesting_structures: Three named injection categories (diagnostic, therapeutic, maintenance) that behave like phases of care.
Two different annual caps: 6 per region per rolling 12 months (Position Statement) vs 8 per 12 months per code family (Reimbursement section). They measure different things and can both bind.
No contraindication list at all, unlike Carelon, Evolent and UHC.
Documentation requirements expressed as LOINC document types with a six-month look-back.
Revision history shows criteria were rewritten many times (04/15/17 'updated criteria', 07/15/19 added home exercise requirements); the current text dropped the explicit home-exercise wording.

fit_to_tree.why: Mostly clean all-of lists with two 'or documentation of inability' escapes. Hazards are the diagnostic/therapeutic/maintenance state (needs injection history to know which list applies), the footnote nesting, and caps that count past procedures.
